en.content:
Let f : R R be a function which satisfies
f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y) x, y R. If f(1) = 2 and
g(n) = , n N then the value of n, for which g(n) = 20, is :
en.explanation:
Given f(1) = 2 ;

f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y)

When x = y = 1 f(2) = 2 + 2 = 4

When x = 2, y = 1 f(3) = 4 + 2 = 6

g(n) =

= f(1) + f(2) +.........+ f(n - 1)

= 2 + 4 + 6 + ......+ 2(n - 1)

= 2

= n2 - n

Given g(n) = 20

n2– n = 20

n2 – n – 20 = 0

n = 5
